comments.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333 

I've spent a bit of time looking at this now, and there are a couple of observations to make:
- Other projects have supplied an implicit truncate call rather than going down this route (see https://github.com/tytso/e2fsprogs/issues/223)
- With either that fix or your proposed fix, two round-trip calls will be needed to the RDP client to open a file with `O_TRUNC`. This has been the case for the FUSE2 implementation. I'm hoping that we can implement `O_TRUNC` by supplying the correct parameters to the DR_CREATE_REQ call, thus needing only one round-trip. So far I've not had much luck doing this, but that would be the preferred solution.
